article.title: Trump WH plans to govern by executive action if Democrats win Congress
article.author: Editor
article.content: Stephen Miller, Russell Vought, and White House counsel have worked since April on tariffs, visa rules, housing costs, and grant changes that would let political appointees steer funding without Congress. The post Trump WH plans to govern by executive action if Democrats win Congress appeared first on MR Online .
